Here is a concise algorithm of how to start learning Lojban.

Duplicate resources were removed to make it shorter and thus more effective.

|style="padding:3px;border:1px solid black;width: 50%;"| <center><span class="plainlinks">search the [https://lojban.herokuapp.com/en/index.html#sisku/pluka live dictionary]<br/>[[Image:la_jbovlaste.png|100px|link=https://lojban.herokuapp.com/en/index.html#sisku/pluka]]<br/>which has more words although they are added by live speakers and may not always be proofread.</span></center>
